text: Bitcoin is outpacing Ethereum with a modest overnight gain while Ethereum lags, suggesting traders are rotating toward the safer major asset amid extreme fear conditions. The Fear & Greed index at 24 remains deeply negative despite rising 12 points over a week, signaling capitulation may be bottoming but conviction hasn't returned. BTC dominance at 55.8% and $78B in daily volume indicate the market is still functioning with reasonable liquidity, though the muted moves across most assets reflect hesitation rather than directional momentum.
